title: A systematic review of generative AI: importance of industry and startup-centered perspectives, agentic AI, ethical considerations & challenges, and future directions
core_idea: Conduct a systematic review of generative AI that synthesizes emerging trends (e.g., large concept models and tool comparisons), examines generative AI's roles across industries and startups, explores agentic AI and multi-agent architectures (including examples like babyagi), and analyzes ethical, transparency, bias, accountability, computational, and deployment challenges to outline future research directions.
tldr: Systematic review aiming to synthesize trends, industry and startup applications, agentic AI approaches, and ethical/challenge landscapes to inform future generative AI research.
